name: unifi-mcp
description: MCP server exposing the four published Ubiquiti UniFi developer APIs (Site Manager, Network, Protect, Mobility) as a single tool surface.

scripts.inspect:cli:http: set -e; SECRET=$(node -e "process.stdout.write(require('node:crypto').randomBytes(24).toString('hex'))"); LOG=$(mktemp); UNIFI_MCP_TRANSPORT=http UNIFI_HTTP_BIND=127.0.0.1 UNIFI_HTTP_PORT=0 UNIFI_HTTP_TOKEN="$SECRET" UNIFI_API_KEY="${UNIFI_API_KEY:-inspect-cli-http-placeholder-key}" UNIFI_CONSOLE_ID="${UNIFI_CONSOLE_ID:-0000000000000000}" node dist/index.js 2>"$LOG" & SERVER=$!; trap 'kill $SERVER 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f "$LOG"' EXIT INT TERM; ENDPOINT=''; TRIES=0; while [ $TRIES -lt 150 ]; do ENDPOINT=$(sed -n 's#.*serving MCP over http at \([^ ]*\).*#\1#p' "$LOG" | head -n 1); [ -n "$ENDPOINT" ] && break; kill -0 $SERVER 2>/dev/null || { cat "$LOG" >&2; echo 'unifi-mcp exited before it bound a listener' >&2; exit 1; }; TRIES=$((TRIES+1)); sleep 0.1; done; [ -n "$ENDPOINT" ] || { cat "$LOG" >&2; echo 'timed out waiting for the serving line' >&2; exit 1; }; echo "inspect:cli:http -> http://$ENDPOINT"; npx --yes "@modelcontextprotocol/inspector${INSPECTOR_VERSION:+@$INSPECTOR_VERSION}" --cli "http://$ENDPOINT" --transport http --header "Authorization: Bearer $SECRET" --method tools/list
